ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with high-intensity (white) regions comprising approximately 20-25% of the visible surface, primarily at the margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white regions at the distal tips; dense white mottling along the entire trailing edge margin; predominantly solid low-intensity black in the central and basal regions; scattered white linear streaks across the interior dark field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 115 degrees and a moderate relative depth to the lobe midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with frequent small-scale serrations; a notable larger concave indentation (nick) is visible on the upper margin of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the leading edges; trailing edges demonstrate a complex concave sweep towards the central notch, interrupted by serrated micro-topography.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, yellowish-white calcified clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks); a series of parallel lines are visible on the mid-left lobe, with shorter unaligned marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant nicks and irregular contour loss along the trailing edge; prominent bio-fouling or parasitic clusters at the fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: The distal tips exhibit 3D texture and multi-colored (white/brown) protrusion beyond the epidermal boundary due to calcified organism colonization.
